text:
omar (solutions): Heads-up: Atlas Retail asked us to onboard Camellia-14B into Dedicated for a beta they want next week. They want 4-bit quant by default, p95 latency <=200ms, steady 40 req/s, and summarization quality within 2% of their current baseline. Artifact: s3://models/atlas/camellia-14b/v1.tar.gz

julia (ml eng): Thanks. Can you confirm the eval suite and sample prompts they expect? Summarization can be sensitive to quant.

omar (solutions): They sent a prompt set (100 samples) and a baseline rouge-l mean = 32.4, bertscore = 0.87. Link: https://drive.redwood/atlas/camellia-evals

sasha (product): Prioritization ask: is this customer on a paid onboarding path? If yes we should move to P1 for next sprint.

anya (customer-success): Atlas is on a mid-enterprise Dedicated contract with 3-month onboarding credits. They expect GA in ~3 weeks but will accept a beta sooner.

julia (ml eng): OK. Proposed plan: 1) smoke bringup unquantized on a small node 2) run baseline eval (their 100 sample set) 3) try 4-bit PTQ and QAT if needed 4) perf tuning (KV cache, batcher) 5) canary to Dedicated pool. Timeline ~4-6 days if infra available.

kevin (infra): GPU availability: west-1 dedicated pool has 8xA10s free this week. For stable 40 req/s with 200ms p95 on 14B, we'll probably use 1 x A100-80GB or 2xA10 with batching. Need to test.

julia (ml eng): Agreed. I'll start with a single A100 test. Quick smoke commands: 
```bash
# docker run smoke bringup
python run_eval.py --model s3://models/atlas/camellia-14b/v1.tar.gz --suite summarization --batch 1 --output /tmp/cam-smoke.json
```

quant-bot: auto-report: initial FP16 smoke pass completed on a100-80gb (latency p95=310ms, throughput 18rps, rouge-l=32.6).

julia (ml eng): FP16 results: p95 too high (310ms). Need quant/perf work. I will try 4-bit PTQ with per-channel quant and KV cache tweaks.

kevin (infra): If quant brings latency down we can fit into 1xA100; if not, we'll allocate 2xA10 and tune batching. Also note: Dedicated instance has CPU memory limit 128GB, watch KV cache memory.

omar (solutions): Customer success asked for a checklist we can share. Can we produce a short public checklist for Atlas?

julia (ml eng): Draft checklist items: 
- confirm artifact integrity (sha256)
- run FP16 smoke eval (latency + quality)
- run 4-bit PTQ smoke eval (same suite)
- compare metrics vs baseline (delta threshold: quality <=2% drop, latency target p95<=200ms)
- if PTQ fails, run lightweight QAT on 1-2 epochs with customer prompts
- validate cold-start + KV cache memory footprint
- run 1hr soak at target rate (40 rps) 
- produce canary deployment plan (traffic shift + rollback)

sasha (product): That looks good. Add: acceptance criteria for GA and sign-off owners (ML Eng: julia, Infra: kevin, CS: anya).

anya (customer-success): I'll coordinate with Atlas for access to their data and to schedule a short demo. They asked if we can try a hybrid fallback to a 7B variant if quality/latency tradeoff is bad.

julia (ml eng): Noted. We should prepare a 7B-compatible variant and a routing policy: prefer camellia-14b, fallback to camellia-7b when p95>250ms or quality drop >5%.

kevin (infra): Can someone open an intake ticket with required artefacts + preferred SLOs? I need the ticket to attach capacity requests.

omar (solutions): Done: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONBRD-4921 (add attachments: s3 artifact link, eval link, contract id).

julia (ml eng): I'll kick off FP16 smoke now and post results. Expect first pass results in ~2h.

quant-bot: queued: run_eval --model camellia-14b --suite summarization --batch 1 --node a100-80gb --notify @julia

sasha (product): Thanks everyone. Can we sync tomorrow 10am PT for a quick stand to review the smoke and next steps? :calendar: :eyes:

anya (customer-success): I'll invite Atlas to observe the demo if the smoke looks promising.

julia (ml eng): Sounds good. Action items: julia run FP16 smoke + 4bit PTQ smoke; kevin reserve node if PTQ passes; anya coordinate data access; sasha own shipping timeline.

omar (solutions): P1 assigned on intake board. Please update the ticket with results.

julia (ml eng): FP16 smoke started (1932106120). Will update with metrics.

quant-bot: update: FP16 smoke completed (1932106750) -- rouge-l=32.5, bertscore=0.869, latency p95=308ms, throughput=19rps.

julia (ml eng): PTQ pass queued (1932106805).

last_message (julia (ml eng)): PTQ quick pass: p95=185ms, throughput=42rps, rouge-l=31.8 (delta -1.9%). Passing our acceptance thresholds. Starting a 1hr soak later today.
